full_page.content:
1951, December 26
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
(To) Rt. Rev. Mgr. Edw'd F. J. Casey St. Thomas College. St. Paul 1, Minnesota
Blessed by God. In all His designs
Dec. 26 - God bless you Father E'd -
Rt. Rev Msg. rather. I meant to reach
you before the beautiful Feast Xmas as indeed was on my mind in
regards to quite some others.
Br. Owen is about to start back for
the West - been here Monday night.
He seems to hold his own, Deo Gr. - back to Chicago first. Thanks be to God We've all
been well here at the St. Felix
lately. with few exceptions.
Now O. B.J. (Owen) comes along and is about to seal his letter. So suggests that
I just put it in with his. . I did hope to have you
call on your return or your
return from your missions
in New York. Thank God
for the success. A Blessed Christmas Season and God protection for the New Year and there after - hereafter. Fr. Solanus, C. F.M. Cap.
